verdict.rationale: Factory documents several ways to run agent work in parallel. Missions launch multi-agent workflows with monitoring of active missions and worker progress. The App isolates each session in its own working directory and lets you filter and group sessions across projects and machines. Headless `droid exec`, the Sessions API, the SDK, and Linear/Jira delegation support batch and programmatic fan-out. missing for 10: an explicit statement of concurrent session/agent capacity or limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration of throughput at scale.
